# Space Station 14
This entry marks the beginning of the advanced guidebook entries. ChromaStation's guidebook has been reworked to be consistent with the lore, epistemics, and content within the server. [color=#a4885c]Reading the setting lore section is heavily recommended![/color]
If you're just here to play, that's great! The [color=#a4885c]Still new?[/color] section of this entry will help you out.
